title: fix(app-shell, plugin-gantt): launcher tile draws app branding; gantt name column names its object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8wLwMKzX6awY8FEtvzGD9X)_

Part of #27386

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：控制台首页的应用图标（及 `app:launcher` 区块）改为读应用自己的品牌：有 `branding.logo` 画 logo，否则有十六进制 `branding.primaryColor` 就用该色的图标块，两者都没有才回到按名字哈希的渐变色；甘特图左侧名称列的表头，绑定对象时改为该对象的标签（如 “Campaign”），不再固定为 “Task Name”。
- **为什么改**：HotCRM 品牌是橙色，首页图标却是粉色（顶栏和应用切换器早已读品牌色，只有首页没读）；活动、合同甘特图的名称列都写着 “Task Name”。卡片第 2、4 行，均为纯 ui 改动，不加新键。
- **风险与回滚**：低。未声明品牌的应用外观不变；内联数据、无标签对象、混合对象树（`objectField`）的甘特表头仍是 “Task Name”。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx` 的 `LauncherAppIcon`；`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` 的 `taskColumnLabel` 传参；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/appTileColors.ts`（从 `AppMark` 移来的共享类名与样式）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomeAppsStrip.branding-27386.test.tsx packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.taskColumnLabel-27386.test.tsx`，预期 7 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Rows 2 and 4 of #27386. Rows 1, 3 and 5 each need a new spec key and go to their own cards (see Acceptance notes).

- **Row 4 — launcher tile branding (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** The home "Your apps" strip, which the `app:launcher` block also mounts, drew every app's 56 px icon square on a gradient picked by hashing `app.name`. It now follows the same ladder `AppMark` draws in the top-bar pill and the app switcher: the `branding.logo` image when declared; else the app's `icon` on its `branding.primaryColor` when that is a hex; else the `icon` on the name-keyed gradient, unchanged. A logo that fails to load falls back to the tile. The favourite badge rides on every face. The branded tile reuses `appTileColors` (light and dark colours), and the tile class string plus its CSS custom properties move from `AppMark.tsx` into `appTileColors.ts` (`BRANDED_TILE_CLASSES`, `appTileStyle`) so both surfaces draw one tile. The colour reaches the DOM only as CSS custom properties that static utilities read (the ui/AGENTS.md section 2 author-declared colour carve-out), as `AppMark` already did.
- **Row 2 — gantt name column title (`@object-ui/plugin-gantt`).** `GanttView` takes an optional `taskColumnLabel` prop and falls back to the `gantt.column.taskName` string. `ObjectGantt` passes the bound object's label, resolved through `useObjectLabel().objectLabel` (the translated object label every other surface uses). It passes nothing, so the heading stays "Task Name", for an inline data set, an object that declares no label, and a mixed-object tree (`gantt.objectField`), whose rows are not all the bound object. No new key: a configurable title is a spec change and stays out (the card's suggestion of a title key on gantt config is not built).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomeAppsStrip.branding-27386.test.tsx` (3 cases): hex colour replaces the gradient and publishes the four custom properties `appTileColors` derives; no colour and a non-hex colour keep the name-keyed gradient; a logo draws, keeps the favourite badge, and falls back to the coloured tile on `error`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.taskColumnLabel-27386.test.tsx` (4 cases): bound object label heads the column; generic heading for an unlabelled object, a mixed-object tree and an inline data set. The generic cases read the heading after the object schema read has settled.

## Acceptance notes

Per-row triage, re-measured on `main` 46943657:

| Row | Bucket | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | CARD (two) | `KanbanConfigSchema` declares `groupByField`, `summarizeField`, `titleField`, `columns` only: no lane list and no hide-empty key. A list view's `filter` is an array of flat `ViewFilterRuleSchema` rules (`field`, `operator`, `value`), AND-only; the `$or` grouping exists only in `FilterConditionSchema`, which a stored view's `filter` does not take. Both need spec keys. |
| 2 | TAKEN (this PR) | Default heading = bound object label; no new key. |
| 3 | CARD | `CalendarConfigSchema` declares five field bindings and no initial-date key; `ObjectCalendar` seeds its current date with `new Date()`. #27895 added Studio settings for calendar and gantt but no such key exists in the spec. |
| 4 | TAKEN (this PR) | Tile reads `branding.logo` / hex `branding.primaryColor`. |
| 5 | CARD | The landing is the first shown nav entry; `homePageId` is retired; `navigationContributions` append only. A per-audience landing is a new app or manifest key. |

- The `tile-grid` page block still tints its generic tiles with `launcherIconGradient(href || label)`: those tiles are authored links, not apps, and carry no branding. Not changed.
- `AppCard.tsx` (the older marketing card) is not mounted by Home or the launcher block; not changed.
